source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Returning Officer's notice of the result, Mid-Ulster Mail 4 Jun 1955 p4 (page image read): no poll in this division, the person entered in column 6 duly elected.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. The only contest was in Ballyronan (Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1955, p. 7; Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). The other twenty-five divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Mid-Ulster Mail, 4 June 1955, p. 4; its heading misprints 'Election of County Councillors'): twenty-three returned without a poll, and in Brackaghslievegallion and Draperstown, where no one was nominated, the retiring members George Holmes and Charles Campbell were deemed re-elected (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
